data: FlexOffers is an affiliate network that delivers over 5 billion in yearly sales, with over 12,000 advertisers and 75,000 publisher sites. We are a final destination that serves as a one-stop shop for those who value convenience. Those who want all their affiliate links, payments, technology, and support services from one team need not go anywhere else.
FlexOffers is proud to partner with the most prominent brands, publishers, creators, and media in the partner marketing space.

FlexOffers is a partner marketing network headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. The company was founded by Alexander Daskaloff in 2006 and is currently led by Chief Executive Officer Dipak Joshi.

FlexOffers was established in 2006 under the name CardOffers.com Partnership Network, initially operating as an affiliate marketing network focused on card-related offers. After approximately five years of operation, the company rebranded as FlexOffers.com, broadening its scope to serve advertisers and publishers across a wider range of verticals.

FlexOffers operates as a partner marketing network facilitating over $5 billion in annual sales, supporting more than 12,000 advertisers and 75,000 publisher sites. Advertisers can host their in-house program on the platform or supplement an existing program through the Publisher Marketplace.

Publishers benefit from custom account management services and platform API solutions, with centralized access to affiliate links, payments, technology, and support services. The company maintains offices in Fort Lauderdale, Miami, San Francisco, and Boston.
FlexOffers has been repeatedly recognized in mThink’s annual Blue Book survey, which ranks the top affiliate marketing networks globally.
The company maintained a top 10 ranking for multiple consecutive years before achieving its highest placement to date in 2024, when it entered the top five.

In 2026, FlexOffers won the MarTech Breakthrough Award for “Partner Marketing Solution of the Year,” from more than 4,000 nominations submitted by global marketing technology companies across AI, edtech, fintech, cybersecurity, and more.

FlexOffers staffs its teams internally rather than outsourcing, with departments spanning affiliate management, publisher management, advertiser management, editorial, accounting, engineering, and development.
Fifty percent of FlexOffers employees have remained with the company for more than six years, and the team collectively holds decades of industry experience.
The company holds a rating above 4.0 stars on Glassdoor and an 80% employee recommendation rate.
